input.question:
PROJECT INFORMATION
All dates are in 2026.
All dates and times are local to America/Los_Angeles.
The project may run on October 19 and October 20 only.
Working hours on each day are 09:00–12:00 and 13:00–17:00.
Lunch is 12:00–13:00.
The project deadline is October 20 at 10:00.
Every task A through N must be completed.

BASELINE PERSONNEL AVAILABILITY
Alex, Maya, and Ethan are each available on both days:
09:00–12:00 and 13:00–17:00.

BASELINE SHARED RESOURCE AVAILABILITY
The GPU and Review Room are each available on both days:
09:00–12:00 and 13:00–17:00.
There is exactly one GPU and exactly one Review Room.

TASKS
Every task requires all listed people and resources simultaneously
for its entire duration.
A dash means no shared resource or no prerequisite, as applicable.

Task | Duration | People | Shared resources | Prerequisites | Additional cost
A | 1 hour | Alex, Maya | Review Room | - | 0
B | 1 hour | Alex | - | A | 0
C | 1 hour | Ethan | - | A | 0
D | 1 hour | Ethan | GPU | B, C | 0
E | 1 hour | Maya | - | A | 0
F | 1 hour | Alex, Ethan | - | D | 0
G, Standard | 2 hours | Ethan | GPU | F | 0
G, Accelerated | 1 hour | Ethan | GPU | F | 5
H | 1 hour | Maya | - | E, F | 0
I | 0.5 hours | Maya, Ethan | Review Room | G, H | 0
J | 0.5 hours | Alex | - | I | 0
K | 0.5 hours | Maya | - | I | 0
L | 0.5 hours | Ethan | GPU | J, K | 0
M | 0.5 hours | Alex, Maya | Review Room | L | 0
N | 0.5 hours | Ethan | GPU | M | 0

For G, select exactly one testing method.
No person or shared resource may be assigned to overlapping tasks.
Tasks must run continuously and cannot cross lunch or day boundaries.
Task start times must fall on 30-minute boundaries.
A task may start at the exact time its final prerequisite finishes.

CHANGE LOG
Only APPROVED changes apply.
An approved change overrides only the information it explicitly mentions.
All other information remains in effect.

1. APPROVED:
Task M may start only on October 20 at or after 09:00.

2. PROPOSED:
Allow F to run during the October 19 lunch break.
This proposal has not been approved.

3. WITHDRAWN:
The proposal to skip task N has been withdrawn.

4. PROPOSED:
Extend the project deadline to October 20 at 10:30.
This proposal has not been approved.

SCENARIOS
Evaluate each scenario independently.

Scenario 1:
The additional-cost budget is 5.
Find a valid schedule with the minimum additional cost.
Among schedules with that cost, choose the earliest completion.
Report the verdict, testing method, additional cost, completion time,
and the date, start, and finish of every task A through N.
Justify feasibility, minimum cost, and earliest completion.

Scenario 2:
The additional-cost budget is 4.
Determine whether every task can be completed by the deadline.
If feasible, provide the optimal schedule and its justification.
If infeasible, explain why.

expected_output.criteria: Accept any valid schedule achieving minimum additional cost and earliest completion. Enforce durations, prerequisites, personnel/resource availability, exclusivity, continuity, lunch/day boundaries, approved changes, budget, and deadline. Evaluate explanation accuracy separately, distinguishing availability windows from task intervals.
